name: Disordered-DABS
description: Disordered-DABS is a benchmark for dynamic aspect-based summarization tailored to unstructured, disordered texts such as social media and customer feedback. It challenges summarization models to handle dynamic aspects in large-scale, unstructured environments.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for dynamic aspect-based summarization with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Developed by adapting existing datasets for cost-efficiency and scalability; poses unique challenges to state-of-the-art summarization models including GPT-3.5.
